She looked older than the photograph beside his bed, but her voice had not changed. “I knew you’d understand,” said his missing sister.","w02":"凌晨四点，城市像一封尚未拆开的信。路灯照着空荡荡的街道，雨水在井盖旁积成微亮的湖。早餐铺卷起铁门，蒸汽带着面香缓缓升起。清洁工推车经过，扫帚擦出细碎的声响。远处一辆夜班公交驶过桥面，车窗里有人睡着，有人望向天边。第一只鸟鸣叫时，楼群背后正泛起浅蓝，街角的猫轻轻越过水洼。","w03":"- Recursion means solving a problem by using the same method on a smaller version of it.\n- Imagine opening a box that contains a smaller box, then opening that box the same way.\n- You need a stopping rule, such as stopping when you reach a box with no box inside."}
